Employs programmatic fetching mechanisms that can download secondary untrusted payloads.

mitre_mapping.relevance: Uses standard web APIs (fetch) to establish external communications.

llm_evaluation.summary: The package 'install-all-setup' contains suspicious code that issues external fetch requests based on parameters extracted from event payloads. This behavior exhibits a 100% structural similarity match to known malicious supply chain packages (defca, zwhrce) and violates security policies prohibiting unexpected outbound network activity in library setup components.
